teaser: hub.agenticcells.site: every agentic site in a repository and an sgit vault, served at its own address, found, promoted and copied as a template.
core_idea: AgentiCCells will list every agentic site it builds on hub.agenticcells.site, a code host for agentic sites: each site in a public repository and an identical sgit vault (cloneable, runnable locally, a distribution medium), served at the customer's domain or our subdomain, with a page per site and templates to copy, listed by consent. A separate agentic team builds it; the first example is a made-up Algarve orange grower selling wholesale with delivery.

nodes.label: Two places
nodes.summary: A repository and an sgit vault.

nodes.label: Consent

quotes.text: A template is only useful if people can find it, see it working, and copy it.
Because our sites are static, a vault is a complete site
Nothing is listed without its owner's consent
